race.comment: THE PERSIAN GOD (11) has been solid in tougher company and he gets the blinkers on for the first time today. Back to maiden company here is a big tick and the slight rise in trip should suit. Likely to get back again, but he looks the one to beat on his recent form. TAG TIME (1) is another with the blinkers on for the first time after a solid return effort as favourite at Northam. He'll be better for that run and the form out of it has worked out nicely. Looks well placed to go one better with the fresh run out of the way. SPONGE CAKE (7) ran her best race out to 1400m in her debut campaign and steps straight to that trip now on the back of a sound fresh run. Loses Pike, but she's a mare trending the right way and she's not to be discounted. GOLD AND GREY (6) is better than she showed last time out and can bounce back. KAMBULA (3) can return on a positive note.
